question: GQ-006
subject: gid 4715 is not one book — it is a recoverable class of 15

c6_reassessed.constraint: "Do not disturb ~/passages.sqlite or the vault corpus WITHOUT COPYING FIRST."
c6_reassessed.status: The copy exists and answers: 77,540 book bodies from the vault copy, verified today by banded checksum over 250,005 rows.
c6_reassessed.reading: C6 is a copy-first condition, not a prohibition. I had been treating it as a blanket "do not touch", which is stricter than what it says and let one book sit unrecovered for several loops.

the_class.reading: All five sampled have HTML editions far larger than their plain-text bodies. gid 4715 has 430,508 bytes of HTML against 8 bytes extracted; 9320 has 163,258 against 75. The plain-text renderings are empty upstream while the works themselves are present in another format.

why_not_done: Ingesting HTML needs a parser this repo does not have, and writing one to recover 15 books of 77,540 is a real piece of work with a real failure mode — a bad parser would inject markup into the passage corpus. The value is bounded and the risk is not, so this is a proposal rather than an action.
what_changed: The framing. I recorded this as "one book, C6 territory, not mine". It is 15 books, C6 permits it because the copy exists, and the blocker is that the tooling does not exist — which is a different and more honest reason to leave it undone.
